title: Only 6.7% of Indian firms have scaled AI
takeaways: Only 6.7% of Indian firms have scaled AI across workflows.
About 59% are stuck in the frozen middle of pilots.
Of every 100 AI ideas, only about 15% reach production.
Just 18% have an AI owner with budget authority.
source_note: Source: Adobe 2026 State of AI Readiness Report (India), via CXOToday
